chapter.verse: Tu-a teng khit, ka khuadak leh vantung ah kongpi kihong khat om hi. Pengkul ging bangin kei hong hopih ka zaksa awging masapen mah in, “Hih takah hong paito inla, hih teng khit-a a piang ding thute kong lak ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Thakhat thu-in Kha sungah ka om a, en un, vantung ah kumpi-tokhom khat omin tua tungah a tu khat om hi.
Tua a tupa in jasper leh carnelian suangmanpha tawh a kibang cilemel nei a, kumpi-tokhom kimkot ah sakhi-tuihup khat omin emerald suangmanpha tawh a kibang cimel nei hi.
Kumpi-tokhom kimkot ah kumpi-tokhom mah sawmnih-le-li om a, tuate tungah puantual paak a silh, a lu tungah kham kumpi-lukhu a khu, makai sawmnih-le-li tu hi.
Kumpi-tokhom tungpanin khuaphia, vanging leh kekkia hong kipankhia hi. Kumpi-tokhom mai-ah Pasian' kha sagihte ahi meitawn kuang sagih om hi.
Kumpi-tokhom mai-ah crystal suangmanpha bangin a siang kilkel, limlang tuipia a bang khat om hi. Kumpi-tokhom kimkot, a pang lite ah a nung a mai mittang tawh a kidim sahing li om hi.
Sahing khatna pen humpi tawh kibang a, sahing nihna pen bawngno tawh, sahing thumna pen mihing' maitang tawh, sahing lina pen musane a lenglai tawh kibang hi.

Tua sahing lite in kha guk ta nei uh a, a khate uh a sung a pua-ah mittang a dimin om hi. Amaute a sun a zan tawlnga lo-in hih bangin ci uh hi: “Siangtho, siangtho, siangtho, Vanglian Topa Pasian, a om ngeisa, tu laitaka om, a hong pai dingpa!”
Sahingte in kumpi-tokhom tunga tu, a tawntung a tawntungin a nungtapa' tungah minphatna, pahtawina leh lungdamkohna a piak simun
makai sawmnih-le-lite pen kumpi-tokhom tunga a tupa' mai-ah boksuk uh a, a tawntung a tawntungin a nungtapa bia uh hi. Amaute in a kumpi-lukhu uh suahkhia-in hih bangin ci uh hi:
“Minphatna, pahtawina leh vangliatna a sang dingin na kilawm hi, kote' Topa leh Pasian, a hang pen na khempeuh na piangsak a, nangma' deihna bangin na khempeuh omin na khempeuh kipiangsak hi.”
